institution: Rajiv Gandhi Government Women and Children Hospital, Puducherry (Department of Microbiology)
citation: Department of Microbiology, Rajiv Gandhi Government Women and Children Hospital, Puducherry. Antibiotic Policy 2017 (guidelines for antimicrobial therapy, valid till May 2018), Antibiogram, p. 21. Puducherry: RGGW&CH; 2017.
reporting: One table of percent susceptible for eight common organisms (columns) and 16 drug rows, hospital-wide, specimen and setting not stated, no isolate numbers. AST method not stated.

verification.note: Page 21 has a native text layer (no page image; the Paper Capture producer applies to other pages). Table parsed with pdfplumber and compared value by value with the page rendered at scale 3; all 16 rows by 8 columns agree.

notes: Antibiogram of the RGGW&CH Antibiotic Policy 2017 (a women and children hospital: obstetrics, gynaecology, paediatrics and NICU), for May 2016 to May 2017. Specimen and setting are not stated, so rows are recorded as all specimens and all settings, and no isolate numbers are printed (rows have no n). Percentages of 0, 33.3, 50, 66.6, 83.3 and 100 in the Proteus, Pseudomonas, S. aureus, CoNS, Providencia and Acinetobacter columns suggest very few isolates. The table has two cefuroxime rows ('Cefuroxime' and 'CXM', which the legend also defines as cefuroxime); the 'Cefuroxime' row is recorded and the differing CXM values are given as conflicts. 'Nx' is defined in the legend as nalidixic acid and recorded as such. Several printed figures are impossible or implausible (for example S. aureus and CoNS beta-lactams above their cefoxitin figure, and 0% for Gram-positive agents in Gram-negative columns); they are recorded as printed and the build suppresses or marks them. The data are from 2016 to 2017; the app keeps them out of pooled views.
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: all 108 cells re-read against the page image (p21, scale 3.5), each value read before comparing, and the 'CXM' row checked against every conflict entry; 0 transcription errors, nothing corrected.

The 4 cefuroxime cautions ('Cefuroxime' and 'CXM' rows differ for Klebsiella 37.5 and 28.1%, Proteus 66.6 and 50%, S. aureus 50 and 100%, Acinetobacter 100 and 0%), the 19 intrinsic and the 7 suppressed cells are printed as recorded.
